title: Engineering Insight
description: Frontmatter schema for Engineering Insight documents in .docs/insights/. Read directly by the site content layer.

number.description: Sequential insight number — must match the NNN prefix in the filename

discovered-during.description: Human-readable context in which the insight emerged (e.g. 'ADR 016', 'PR #29')

related-adr.description: ADR number this insight relates to, if any
